The '''Wicked Statue''' is a [[Crafting|crafted]] piece of [[Furniture]]. Its recipe can be obtained from [[Krobus]] for {{Price|1000}}.

Placing a Wicked Statue in a [[Slime Hutch]] prevents the witch from visiting it and turning all [[Slimes]] black.

When monster spawns are enabled on [[the Farm]], whenever a monster spawns, any Wicked Statues on the Farm will shake and have their eyes glow red for a short duration.<ref name="redeyes"/>
